decisions.reason: The deadline modifies the qualification trial schedule but does not change the submission channel or required submission content.
The trial submission deadline does not change the monthly quota of 125 approved clips.
The deadline for the prerequisite trial does not alter the deferred Lead Clipper role, its pathway, or its responsibilities.
Changing the trial submission deadline does not alter the permitted source or topic constraint.
The deadline statement does not change the standard for selecting strong source moments.
The submission deadline has no effect on the requirement to use color in captions or letters.
The submission deadline does not change the required 30–90-second clip duration.
The deadline statement does not modify the clean editing-style requirement.
